name: openapi-person-face-provisioning
title: 第三方平台人员与人脸 OpenAPI 下发接收
description: 支持外部平台通过安全 Bearer Token OpenAPI 下发并维护人员与人脸档案（单人增量同步/细粒度人脸管理/溯源标记与WebUI凭证管理）
scope: cross-layer: M2M Bearer auth + person/face OpenAPI + SQLite migrations + Web UI token panel/source badge
creator: nikoniko
notes: Review revised v3: external personId anchor (internal ULID hidden), independent /api/v1/openapi route group with a 1 MiB JSON sub-group, atomic replace=true (foreign key safe + single-delete-upsert gallery broadcast), unified 422 image errors plus an explicit statusFor(code) table mapping FILE_TOO_LARGE to 413, token CRUD + soft revoke with table-wide unique name, source=creation origin, coalesced last_used_at with sync.WaitGroup graceful drain, api_token.auth_rejected audit on failed auth, limiter strictly on POST /faces (no false 429 on DELETE) at 3/1 concurrency, securityDefinitions in cmd/Zhulong/main.go. Migrations are pinned to 000027/000028 (000026 stays with 11-03-alert-push-multi-channel). Magic-byte-only validation on the OpenAPI face path so extension-less uploads are accepted.
